data.fund_name: Mirae Asset Ultra Short Duration Fund
data.fund_type: An Open ended ultra-short term debt scheme investing in instruments such that the Macaulay duration* of the portfolio isbetween 3 months to 6 months (*please refer to page no.12 of SID). A relatively low interest rate risk and moderate creditrisk.
